name: Box2D v3 (box2d3-wasm)
role: 2D rigid-body physics as WASM in Node, stepped at a fixed timestep and baked to per-frame positions
summary: Box2D v3 is Erin Catto's C engine; box2d3-wasm is a third-party npm build of v3.2 with compat (no threads) and deluxe (SIMD and threads) variants. The C-style API steps a world by a fixed dt, so positions are read per frame and cached. The author states cross-platform determinism; the fixture checks only single-machine repeatability.
use_when: 2D rigid bodies (circles, boxes, joints) baked to per-frame transforms in Node and replayed in a scene
Over matter-js when stable stacking, many bodies or a determinism claim from the engine author matter
Over rapier when only 2D is needed and a small C-style API is preferred
avoid_when: A few 2D bodies in the browser with no WASM wanted: matter-js
Scripted motion with no collisions: anime-js or theatre-js
notes: 2026-11-27: Bake, do not seek: step every frame from t=0 and cache positions. Vector getters return owned wasm objects; call .delete() on them. The compat and deluxe builds gave identical trajectories on one machine. The engine's cross-platform determinism claim is unverified here, and the binding's maintainer is a third party.

assessment.rationale: MIT for engine and binding; box2d3-wasm 6.0.0 (2026-10-26) installs with one pnpm dependency and runs in Node with no browser or system install. The lead named Homebrew stable 3.2.0; the npm binding pins a patched v3.2 fork. Adds an engine-author determinism claim that matter-js and pymunk do not make; the claim itself is not verified across platforms.

evidence.result: Three circles dropped on a floor, 90 steps at 1/30 s, 4 sub-steps in Node 22.19.0; trajectory JSON identical across two processes (SHA-256 d9b9285b...4b90) and across compat and deluxe builds; all finite, bounced, settled at y 0.4997, 0.4999, 0.7912; min y 0.3657.
evidence.scope: Rigid circles on a static box, one machine (macOS arm64); not joints, other shapes, other platforms, seeking, replay, or playback in a scene. Settling is incomplete at frame 89.
